artists.name: Molotov
artists.description: Molotov is a Mexican rock band formed in Mexico City in 1995. They are known for their unique blend of rock, rap, and funk, combined with provocative and politically charged lyrics that often address social and political issues in Mexico and Latin America. The band gained international recognition for their energetic performances and controversial songs that challenge authority and societal norms.

artists.name: El Cuarteto de Nos
artists.description: El Cuarteto De Nos is a prominent Uruguayan rock band formed in the early 1980s, known for their unique blend of rock, alternative, and Latin influences combined with humorous and satirical lyrics. The band has evolved over the decades, incorporating various musical styles and maintaining a strong presence in Latin American music. Their clever wordplay and storytelling have earned them critical acclaim and a dedicated fan base.

artists.name: Rauw Alejandro
artists.description: Rauw Alejandro is a Puerto Rican singer and songwriter who has gained international fame for his contributions to reggaeton, Latin urban, and Latin pop music. He is known for blending traditional reggaeton rhythms with contemporary R&B and trap influences, creating a modern and versatile sound. Since his debut, he has become one of the leading figures in the Latin music scene, known for his smooth vocals and dynamic performances.

artists.name: O'funk'illo
artists.description: O'Funk'illo is a Spanish band formed in the early 1990s, known for blending funk rock and funk metal with humorous lyrics and energetic performances. The band combines elements of rock, metal, and funk to create a distinctive sound characterized by groovy bass lines, funky guitar riffs, and dynamic vocals. Their music often features playful and satirical themes, making them a unique presence in the Spanish rock scene.

artists.name: Nathy Peluso
artists.description: Nathy Peluso is an Argentine singer and songwriter who blends a variety of genres including Latin, hip hop, rap, R&B, and soul, with influences from jazz, funk, reggaeton, and trap. She is recognized for her powerful vocals, dynamic stage presence, and innovative musical style that fuses traditional Latin sounds with contemporary urban music. Peluso has gained international acclaim for her unique voice and artistic versatility.

artists.name: Gustavo Cerati
artists.description: Gustavo Cerati was an influential Argentine musician, singer-songwriter, and producer, best known as the lead vocalist and guitarist of the iconic Latin American rock band Soda Stereo. After the band's breakup, he pursued a successful solo career, blending rock with electronic and experimental sounds. Cerati is celebrated for his poetic lyrics, innovative music production, and significant impact on Latin American rock music.

artists.name: Babasónicos
artists.description: Babasónicos is an Argentine rock band formed in the early 1990s, recognized for their eclectic blend of rock, pop, and electronic music. They have been influential in the Latin American rock scene, known for their innovative sound and artistic music videos. The band combines elements of alternative rock, psychedelic rock, and funk, creating a unique and evolving musical style over their career.

artists.name: Tus Amigos Nuevos
artists.description: Tus Amigos Nuevos is a Latin music group specializing in Regional Mexican genres such as Norteño and Banda. They are known for their traditional Mexican instrumentation and vocal styles, contributing to the contemporary Mexican music scene.

watch_now.name: El mariachi
watch_now.description: El Mariachi (early 1990s), written and directed by Robert Rodriguez and starring Carlos Gallardo, Consuelo Gómez and Jaime de Hoyos, is a lean action-crime-thriller produced on a micro-budget. The film follows a wandering mariachi who is mistaken for a ruthless hitman because of an identical guitar case, triggering a violent manhunt led by criminal factions. Blending pulpy revenge motifs and a tender romantic strand, the picture is notable for its inventive, do-it-yourself filmmaking, kinetic camerawork, and relentless pacing.

watch_now.name: Sin nombre
watch_now.description: Sin Nombre (2009), directed by Cary Joji Fukunaga and starring Paulina Gaitán, Marco Antonio Aguirre and Leonardo Alonso, is a gritty crime-adventure drama about migration and gang violence. The film follows a Honduran teen traveling north and a young Mexican gang member on the run as their paths collide aboard freight trains bound for the United States. Fukunaga uses handheld, naturalistic cinematography and raw performances to explore poverty, loyalty, and moral complexity, producing a tense, emotionally affecting portrait of survival and hope.

watch_now.name: El espinazo del diablo
watch_now.description: The Devil's Backbone (2001), directed by Guillermo del Toro and starring Marisa Paredes, Eduardo Noriega and Federico Luppi, is a Spanish drama-horror set during the aftermath of the Spanish Civil War. The story follows a twelve-year-old boy sent to an isolated orphanage where he encounters a ghost, an unexploded bomb, and a web of secrets centered on a cruel caretaker and a bullying peer. Combining gothic supernatural elements with a character-driven wartime drama, the film explores themes of loss, guilt, betrayal, and revenge with a haunting, melancholic tone.

watch_now.name: Hogar
watch_now.description: The Occupant (2020), directed by David Pastor and Àlex Pastor and starring Javier Gutiérrez, Mario Casas and Bruna Cusí, is a Spanish-language drama-thriller about a former executive forced to sell his family home. After leaving the house, he becomes obsessively involved with the family that now occupies it, and his voyeurism escalates into stalking and moral collapse. The film is a slow-burn psychological thriller with noir touches that explores themes of class conflict, obsession and economic insecurity, delivered with tense, unsettling atmosphere and meticulous cinematography.

watch_now.name: Celda 211
watch_now.description: Cell 211 (2009), directed by Daniel Monzón and starring Luis Tosar, Alberto Ammann and Antonio Resines, is a Spanish action-crime drama thriller set during a sudden prison uprising. The film follows a trainee guard who poses as an inmate to survive, triggering a tense struggle with the prison’s powerful inmate leader and exposing corruption among officials. Combining gritty, intimate visuals with morally ambiguous storytelling, it examines power, loyalty and the costs of survival while delivering relentless suspense and strong performances.

watch_now.name: La isla mínima
watch_now.description: Marshland (La Isla Mínima) is a 2014 Spanish crime-mystery thriller directed by Alberto Rodríguez and starring Javier Gutiérrez, Raúl Arévalo and María Varod. Set in the early 1980s during Spain's transition from dictatorship, two contrasting homicide detectives investigate the disappearance of teenage sisters in the isolated Andalusian marshes. The film blends procedural investigation with political undercurrents, exposing corruption, sexual violence and communal secrets while maintaining a tense, moody atmosphere. Outstanding cinematography and layered performances emphasize the landscape as a central, haunting presence.

stretch.name: Bajocero
stretch.description: Below Zero (2021), directed by Lluís Quílez and starring Javier Gutiérrez, Karra Elejalde, and Luis Callejo, is a Spanish-language action-crime thriller that stages a brutal ambush of a prison transport on a lonely road. The plot follows an injured escorting officer who fortifies a transport vehicle while inmates and attackers attempt to finish him, producing a tense, violent survival standoff. The film mixes gritty, claustrophobic visuals with moral ambiguity and revenge-driven motives, delivering high-adrenaline suspense and occasional graphic violence.

stretch.name: Aterrados
stretch.description: Terrified (Spanish: Aterrados) is a 2017 Argentine supernatural horror film written and directed by Demián Rugna, starring Maximiliano Ghione, Norberto Gonzalo and Elvira Onetto. The film follows a trio of investigators who probe a Buenos Aires neighborhood beset by inexplicable phenomena, uncovering escalating apparitions, eerie sounds and reality-bending events. Combining folkloric motifs with psychological horror, the narrative examines trauma, grief and the erosion of sanity as dread intensifies. Its sound-driven, practical-effects style creates a suffocating atmosphere that lingers after viewing.

stretch.name: Acción mutante
stretch.description: Mutant Action (1993), directed by Álex de la Iglesia and starring Antonio Resines, Álex Angulo and Frédérique Feder, is a darkly comic Spanish sci‑fi thriller that mashes dystopian satire with pulp violence. The plot follows a band of disfigured mutant terrorists who kidnap a wealthy heiress and flee to a lawless mining planet, where loyalties fracture and grotesque encounters escalate. Combining black humor, genre spoofing and social critique of beauty‑obsessed bourgeois culture, the film is energetic, stylized and frequently violent. Its tone and imagery established early markers of de la Iglesia's distinctive, cult-oriented filmmaking.

stretch.name: Monos
stretch.description: Monos (2019), directed by Alejandro Landes, is a Colombian adventure-drama-thriller starring Sofia Buenaventura, Julián Giraldo and Karen Quintero alongside Julianne Nicholson. The film follows a group of teenage guerrillas who guard an American hostage and a milk cow on a remote mountaintop before descending into the jungle. Shot in vivid, atmospheric style, it emphasizes cinematography, sound design and episodic scenes of violence and intimacy to probe themes of power, loyalty and lost innocence. The result is a challenging, visceral art-house work that prioritizes emotional impact and moral ambiguity.

stretch.name: El guardián invisible
stretch.description: The Invisible Guardian (2017), directed by Fernando González Molina and starring Marta Etura, Elvira Mínguez and Carlos Librado 'Nene', is a Spanish crime-mystery thriller filmed in Spanish with Basque and English elements. The plot follows a female homicide inspector investigating a series of ritualized murders in the forest while confronting traumatic family secrets and local legends. Blending police procedural beats with psychological drama and folkloric overtones, the film emphasizes atmosphere, cinematography and emotional intensity. Its tone is tense, brooding and melancholy, favoring slow-burn suspense over action.

stretch.name: Juan de los muertos
stretch.description: Juan of the Dead (2011), directed by Alejandro Brugués and starring Alexis Díaz de Villegas, Jorge Molina, and Andros Perugorría, is an action-horror comedy set amid a Cuban zombie outbreak. A ragtag group of slackers launches a paid zombie‑extermination business while state media insists the victims are dissidents, producing a blend of slapstick humor, inventive practical effects, and bloody set pieces. The film uses its genre trappings to deliver pointed political satire about propaganda and profiteering, anchored by warm character moments and irreverent tone.

later.name: Balada triste de trompeta
later.description: The Last Circus (2010), directed by Álex de la Iglesia and starring Carlos Areces, Antonio de la Torre and Carolina Bang, is a darkly comic and violent drama that mixes horror and wartime allegory. The story follows a young trapeze artist caught between two deeply disturbed clowns, turning a love triangle into a brutal spectacle amid Spain's political violence. With baroque, carnivalesque visuals, jagged editing and black-humored absurdity, the film interrogates obsession, jealousy and the theatricalization of trauma. Its tone is simultaneously grotesque, tragic and darkly funny, appealing to viewers who favor provocative, genre-blending cinema.

later.name: El desconocido
later.description: Retribution (directed by Dani de la Torre) is a tense action-crime drama starring Luis Tosar, Javier Gutiérrez and Elvira Mínguez. The film follows a banker who, while driving his children, receives a call from an anonymous extortionist claiming bombs are hidden in the car and demanding a ransom. Combining roadbound suspense and hostage-style pressure with high production values and a bravura single-take staging, the story explores themes of revenge, parental protection and the moral consequences of past wrongdoing, delivering relentless, edge-of-your-seat tension.

later.name: Ánimas Trujano
later.description: The Important Man (Animas Trujano) is a 1961 Mexican drama directed by Ismael Rodríguez and starring Toshiro Mifune, Columba Domínguez and Flor Silvestre. The film follows an irresponsible Indigenous villager who longs to be chosen mayordomio, cheating and gambling his way through life as opportunities for reform and honor repeatedly slip away. Rooted in social realism and moral conflict, the story explores themes of honor, religion, class and redemption. Tone and performances blend dark comedy and pathos to create a powerful, character-driven morality tale.

later.name: El milagro de P. Tinto
later.description: The Miracle of P. Tinto (1998), directed by Javier Fesser and starring Luis Ciges, Janusz Ziemniak and Pablo Pinedo, is a Spanish comic fantasy that mixes surreal visual invention with tender themes of family and parenthood. The plot follows a childless couple who, in their quest for an heir to a family wafer factory and its long-standing Vatican contract, accumulate a parade of eccentric adoptees: two tiny extraterrestrials, an asylum escapee, and other misfits. Structured as a series of wildly imaginative vignettes — including parodied asylum sequences, newsreels, and temporal jumps — the film balances outlandish comedy with heartfelt emotion and satirical commentary on bureaucracy and belonging.

later.name: La teta asustada
later.description: The Milk of Sorrow (2009), directed by Claudia Llosa and starring Magaly Solier, Susi Sánchez, and Efraín Solís, is a Spain-produced drama with strong musical and ritual elements rooted in Peruvian indigenous culture. It follows a young woman believed to carry a psychosocial illness transmitted through her mother’s breast milk as she confronts her mother’s death, journeys to earn money, and seeks a traditional burial. The film is notable for its composed, lyrical cinematography, use of Quechua song, and its exploration of intergenerational trauma and political violence. Its emotional tone is melancholic yet quietly hopeful as it traces a path from inherited fear toward fragile agency.

later.name: La sociedad de la nieve
later.description: Society of the Snow (2023/2024) is a dramatized true‑story film directed by J. A. Bayona and starring Enzo Vogrincic, Agustín Pardella and Matías Recalt. The film recounts the 1972 crash of a Uruguayan plane in the Andes and follows the handful of survivors as they battle freezing temperatures, starvation, isolation and wrenching moral choices. Combining adventure, historical biography and thriller elements, it foregrounds themes of solidarity, sacrifice and trauma and delivers a bleak yet empathetic emotional tone through rigorous, cinematic visuals.

unmeasured.name: Señorita 89
unmeasured.description: Señorita 89 (released 2022) is a Chilean–Mexican–Spanish drama thriller starring Ilse Salas, Ximena Romo, and Natasha Dupeyrón. The series follows thirty-two contestants who enter a three-month preparation for a national beauty contest, where backstage power dynamics, exploitation, and a hidden crime force alliances and reckonings. Across tense, character-driven episodes it probes themes of corruption, gender inequality, trauma, and solidarity, delivering a dark, emotionally charged critique of institutional control.

unmeasured.name: Secuestro del vuelo 601
unmeasured.description: The Hijacking of Flight 601 is a 2024 television series starring Monica Lopera, Valentín Villafañe, and Alián Devetac. Set around the hijacking of a passenger plane, it follows the crew, passengers, negotiators, and hijackers as a tense standoff unfolds over political demands and ransom. The series blends drama, thriller, and historical elements with moments of humanity and dark humor, highlighting inequality, survival, and the human impact of political violence.

unmeasured.name: Frontera Verde
unmeasured.description: Frontera Verde (2019) is a Colombian crime-drama thriller miniseries in which a young Bogotá detective ventures into the Amazon to investigate four femicides and becomes enmeshed in indigenous shamanism, environmental conflict, and hidden personal origins. The first episode was directed by Ciro Guerra; the principal cast includes Juana del Rio, Angela Cano, and Nelson Camayo. Combining slow-burn pacing with lush, atmospheric cinematography and poetic indigenous dialogue, the series explores themes of identity, environmentalism, police corruption, spiritual mysticism, and gendered violence. Its tone is contemplative, haunting, and suspenseful, favoring character-driven storytelling over conventional procedural beats.

unmeasured.name: Pálpito
unmeasured.description: The Marked Heart (2022) is a Colombian Spanish-language drama-mystery-thriller starring Michel Brown, Ana Lucía Domínguez, and Sebastián Martínez. The series follows a widower whose wife's heart is illicitly harvested and transplanted into the spouse of a wealthy man, driving him into the clandestine world of organ trafficking as he seeks revenge. Through its serialized melodrama and crime suspense, the show explores grief, love, obsession, and systemic corruption while delivering tense, twist-driven storytelling. The emotional tone is tense and melancholic, aiming to keep viewers both shocked and emotionally engaged.

unmeasured.name: Metástasis
unmeasured.description: Metástasis (released 2014) is a Colombian Spanish-language remake of the U.S. crime drama Breaking Bad starring Diego Trujillo, Roberto Urbina, and Sandra Reyes. The series follows a terminally ill chemistry teacher who begins manufacturing and selling methamphetamine after a cancer diagnosis, tracing his transformation into an antihero. Across a serialized 62-episode arc, the show examines themes of family, desperation, and moral decline through a tense, character-driven lens. Its tone is gritty and unsettling, blending intimate domestic drama with the mechanics of the drug trade.

unmeasured.name: El silencio
unmeasured.description: Muted (2023) is a Spanish-language crime drama miniseries starring Arón Piper, Almudena Amor, and Cristina Kovani. It follows Sergio, who stopped speaking after being accused of murdering his parents, as a teenage girl’s arrival and a renewed inquiry threaten to unearth conflicting truths. Across its episodes the series blends psychological suspense and investigative mystery to examine guilt, social judgment, and the effects of trauma and isolation. The tone is dark and atmospheric, with a slow-burn, character-focused approach that emphasizes moral ambiguity.

held_back.name: Balada triste de trompeta
held_back.description: The Last Circus (2010), directed by Álex de la Iglesia and starring Carlos Areces, Antonio de la Torre and Carolina Bang, is a darkly comic and violent drama that mixes horror and wartime allegory. The story follows a young trapeze artist caught between two deeply disturbed clowns, turning a love triangle into a brutal spectacle amid Spain's political violence. With baroque, carnivalesque visuals, jagged editing and black-humored absurdity, the film interrogates obsession, jealousy and the theatricalization of trauma. Its tone is simultaneously grotesque, tragic and darkly funny, appealing to viewers who favor provocative, genre-blending cinema.

event.text: Writing a reason for each pick

9B96C58A-70F8-4051-9A18-A8AB35F5BA4B.en: Offering razor-sharp, adrenaline-fueled action, this gritty thriller shares the high-stakes suspense, danger, and dark edge of your favourites.
9B96C58A-70F8-4051-9A18-A8AB35F5BA4B.fr: Offrant une action vive et pleine d'adrénaline, ce thriller captivant partage le suspense intense, le danger et le ton sombre de vos favoris.
9B96C58A-70F8-4051-9A18-A8AB35F5BA4B.es: Con una acción vibrante y llena de adrenalina, este crudo thriller comparte el suspense intenso, el peligro y el toque oscuro de tus favoritos.

D6C5195F-9A65-47E5-85A5-C942E390765A.en: Exploring survival and grit, this harrowing crime drama delivers the intense danger and emotional rawness that define your favourites.
D6C5195F-9A65-47E5-85A5-C942E390765A.fr: Explorant la survie et le cran, ce drame criminel poignant offre le danger intense et la rudesse émotionnelle qui caractérisent vos favoris.
D6C5195F-9A65-47E5-85A5-C942E390765A.es: Explorando la supervivencia y el valor, este conmovedor drama criminal ofrece el peligro intenso y la crudeza emocional que definen tus favoritos.

8FBAA194-96F4-4D46-9478-B5D2295F92AA.en: Blending historical drama with haunting mystery, it shares the same eerie, quest-like atmosphere and deep emotional weight as The Legend of Zelda.
8FBAA194-96F4-4D46-9478-B5D2295F92AA.fr: Mêlant drame historique et mystère envoûtant, il partage la même atmosphère étrange et quêteuse ainsi que la profondeur émotionnelle de The Legend of Zelda.
8FBAA194-96F4-4D46-9478-B5D2295F92AA.es: Combinando drama histórico y un misterio inquietante, comparte la misma atmósfera fantasmal y de búsqueda y la profunda carga emocional de The Legend of Zelda.

755051F8-D604-4E93-89E0-04897E4B93F7.en: Built on moral ambiguity and psychological tension, this domestic thriller captures the relentless suspense and dark tone uniting your favourites.
755051F8-D604-4E93-89E0-04897E4B93F7.fr: Fondé sur l'ambiguïté morale et la tension psychologique, ce thriller domestique saisit le suspense incessant et le ton sombre qui unissent vos favoris.
755051F8-D604-4E93-89E0-04897E4B93F7.es: Basado en la ambigüedad moral y la tensión psicológica, este thriller doméstico capta el suspense incesante y el tono oscuro que unen tus favoritos.

E4BEE81E-B0DE-4103-8814-C29D48163E05.en: Plunging into institutional corruption and extreme survival, this gritty crime drama mirrors the relentless tension and moral grey areas of your favourites.
E4BEE81E-B0DE-4103-8814-C29D48163E05.fr: Plongeant dans la corruption institutionnelle et la survie extrême, ce drame criminel rugueux reflète la tension constante et les zones grises de vos favoris.
E4BEE81E-B0DE-4103-8814-C29D48163E05.es: Sumergiéndose en la corrupción institucional y la supervivencia extrema, este crudo drama criminal refleja la tensión constante y los matices morales de tus favoritos.

C20A60F3-E9B8-42A4-B12F-D9F65C93A71D.en: Steeped in simmering dread and dark mystery, this crime thriller echoes the intense suspense, corruption, and bleak mood of your favourites.
C20A60F3-E9B8-42A4-B12F-D9F65C93A71D.fr: Imprégné d'une angoisse sourde et d'un sombre mystère, ce thriller policier fait écho au suspense intense, à la corruption et à l'atmosphère sombre de vos favoris.
C20A60F3-E9B8-42A4-B12F-D9F65C93A71D.es: Inmerso en una inquietud latente y un oscuro misterio, este thriller criminal evoca el suspense intenso, la corrupción y el tono sombrío de tus favoritos.

C738BC6F-7D81-49ED-AF21-26A16E7E1738.en: Driven by claustrophobic suspense and visceral violence, this action-crime thriller matches the relentless danger and gritty edge of your favourites.
C738BC6F-7D81-49ED-AF21-26A16E7E1738.fr: Porté par un suspense claustrophobique et une violence viscérale, ce thriller d'action et de crime égale le danger implacable et le ton rugueux de vos favoris.
C738BC6F-7D81-49ED-AF21-26A16E7E1738.es: Impulsado por un suspense claustrofóbico y una violencia visceral, este thriller de acción y crimen iguala el peligro implacable y el tono crudo de tus favoritos.

5D0E6B6C-ABC6-49A4-BD78-1E628BC9D66B.en: Sharing the intense tension and gritty edge of Breaking Bad and The Legend of Zelda, this slow-burn supernatural horror builds relentless dread through paranormal investigation and trauma.
5D0E6B6C-ABC6-49A4-BD78-1E628BC9D66B.fr: Partageant la tension intense et le mordant de Breaking Bad et The Legend of Zelda, cet horrifique surnaturel à combustion lente installe une terreur persistante à travers une enquête paranormale.
5D0E6B6C-ABC6-49A4-BD78-1E628BC9D66B.es: Compartiendo la intensa tensión y el tono crudo de Breaking Bad y The Legend of Zelda, este terror sobrenatural de desarrollo lento construye un pavor constante mediante la investigación paranormal.

FD362290-673A-454F-A796-634A22A7C806.en: Fusing dark humor, grit, and high-stakes chaos much like Breaking Bad and The Legend of Zelda, this dystopian thriller delivers biting satire and anarchic energy.
FD362290-673A-454F-A796-634A22A7C806.fr: Mariant humour noir, âpreté et chaos à hauts risques à la manière de Breaking Bad et The Legend of Zelda, ce thriller dystopique offre une satire mordante et une énergie anarchique.
FD362290-673A-454F-A796-634A22A7C806.es: Fusionando humor negro, crudeza y caos de alto riesgo muy al estilo de Breaking Bad y The Legend of Zelda, este thriller distópico ofrece una sátira mordaz y energía anárquica.

380AEFF3-6D3E-49D1-B2BD-DD3145A683F6.en: Driven by the gritty danger and gripping survival themes found in Breaking Bad and The Legend of Zelda, this tense drama explores harsh group dynamics and political conflict.
380AEFF3-6D3E-49D1-B2BD-DD3145A683F6.fr: Porté par le danger âpre et les thèmes prenants de survie de Breaking Bad et The Legend of Zelda, ce drame tendu explore des dynamiques de groupe brutales et un conflit politique.
380AEFF3-6D3E-49D1-B2BD-DD3145A683F6.es: Impulsado por el peligro crudo y los cautivadores temas de supervivencia de Breaking Bad y The Legend of Zelda, este tenso drama explora dinámicas de grupo brutales y conflictos políticos.

A97BC078-852C-4A04-8B10-516CA8DD245B.en: Unfolding with the suspenseful tension and dark moral complexity of Breaking Bad and The Legend of Zelda, this moody crime thriller delves into unsettling family secrets.
A97BC078-852C-4A04-8B10-516CA8DD245B.fr: Se déployant avec la tension suspense et la sombre complexité morale de Breaking Bad et The Legend of Zelda, ce thriller policier ténébreux plonge dans de troublants secrets de famille.
A97BC078-852C-4A04-8B10-516CA8DD245B.es: Desarrollándose con la tensa intriga y la oscura complejidad moral de Breaking Bad y The Legend of Zelda, este sombrío thriller policial se adentra en inquietantes secretos familiares.

F159F807-5065-465C-839C-FEFC2C9DDB1D.en: Echoing the adventurous spirit and thrilling danger of The Legend of Zelda, this horror-comedy blends survival and dark satire with bloody zombie action.
F159F807-5065-465C-839C-FEFC2C9DDB1D.fr: Faisant écho à l'esprit d'aventure et au danger palpitant de The Legend of Zelda, cette comédie horrifique mêle survie et satire noire à une action sanglante de zombies.
F159F807-5065-465C-839C-FEFC2C9DDB1D.es: Haciendo eco del espíritu aventurero y el peligro emocionante de The Legend of Zelda, esta comedia de terror combina la supervivencia y la sátira oscura con sangrienta acción zombi.

CF56D60B-B707-47E1-9195-B267917669D3.en: Channeling the dark, intense atmosphere and morally grey chaos of Breaking Bad and The Legend of Zelda, this surreal piece blends visceral horror with tragic black comedy.
CF56D60B-B707-47E1-9195-B267917669D3.fr: Canalisant l'atmosphère sombre et intense ainsi que le chaos aux nuances morales de Breaking Bad et The Legend of Zelda, cette œuvre surréaliste mêle horreur viscérale et comédie noire tragique.
CF56D60B-B707-47E1-9195-B267917669D3.es: Canalizando la atmósfera oscura e intensa y el caos moralmente ambiguo de Breaking Bad y The Legend of Zelda, esta obra surrealista mezcla terror visceral con una trágica comedia negra.
